function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_built_in_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of built-in event specifications using their IDs. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ids.description: A list of event specification IDs to retrieve. Each ID is a string uniquely identifying an event specification.

function.description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications using their unique identifiers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_ids.description: An array of event specification identifiers to fetch details for.

include_details.description: Flag to determine whether to include detailed information for each event specification.

function.description: Retrieve the specifications for a custom event by its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

eventSpecificationId.description: The unique identifier of the custom event specification.
